learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic concepts of electromechanical energy conversion and use these concepts in solving problems
Understand the operation principles of single and three phase transformers and analyze their performance

Understand the operation principles of alternating current and direct current machines, and are be able to conduct performance analysis of these machines by using these principles with the use of equivalent circuits.
Carry out simple electromechanical system designs

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: Definition of electromechanical energy conversion. Review of basic laws. Basic methods and concepts that are necessary in the analysis of magnetic circuits.
ELECTROMAGNETIC CIRCUITS: Calculation of self and mutual inductance. Hysteresis phenomenon. Losses in electromagnetic circuits. Permanent magnets. Analysis of systems containing permanent magnets.

TRANSFORMERS: Operation principles and applications of single phase transformers. Ideal and non-ideal transformers. Calculation of equivalent circuit parameters. Efficiency and regulation. Three phase transformers.
ELECTROMAGNETIC ENERGY CONVERSION: Definition and calculation of stored energy. Energy balance for motor and generator operations. Co-energy. Force and torque calculation.
ELECTROMAGNETIC ENERGY CONVERSION: Singly and multiply excited systems. Force and torque in permanent magnet systems.
DC MACHINES: DC machine fundamentals. Induced voltage and torque equations. Equivalent circuit.
DC MACHINES: Separately excited, shunt, series and compound dc machines. Speed and voltage regulation and efficiency. Permanent magnet dc machines.
AC MACHINES: AC machine fundamentals. Rotating fields and pole concept. MMK and flux distributions. Voltage and torque generation.
SYNCHRONOUS MACHINES: Principles and construction. Equivalent circuit and analysis. Phasor analysis. Power and torque relationship. Operation under load.
THREE PHASE INDUCTION MOTORS: Operation principles and structure. Types of IMs. Analysis through equivalent circuit. Calculation of equivalent circuit parameters. Speed control.
SINGLE PHASE INDUCTION MOTORS: Operation principles and types. Calculation of equivalent circuit parameters and analysis. Application areas.
OTHER SPECIAL MOTORS: Operation principles of reluctance motors, universal motor, step motor, hysteresis motor and other special purpose motors.
